svg.title: CASTAWAY: menu disk 1992
svg.desc: An imaginary Atari ST style menu screen for Castaway, a ten-hour lo-fi island video: a wobbling orange slab logo over rolling red rasters, a dithered picture of a tiny sunny island where she sits nodding by the palm while a bottle drifts in and straight back out, a key list of the project's own tools, and a big pink scroller along the bottom.
